manual_review_required: The Nexus Dashboard infrastructure team serves as the backbone of our platform, engineering the critical services that ensure stability, security, and seamless lifecycle management for our global data center customers. By managing the core Kubernetes-based architecture, our team provides the essential foundation upon which advanced orchestration, telemetry, and policy services are built and scaled. We are a fast-paced, dynamic group of engineers who thrive on collaboration and constant innovation, working closely with cross-functional teams to solve complex infrastructure challenges in real-time. We foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence, making this the ideal environment for engineers who are passionate about building robust, high-scale infrastructure.

Joining Nexus Dashboard infrastructure team means operating at the cutting edge of platform technologies, where you will have the opportunity to directly influence the future of data center automation and platform reliability.

- Core Platform Engineering: Architect and maintain the core infrastructure of the Nexus Dashboard, a Kubernetes-based platform, ensuring high availability and performance across its integrated data stack, including PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Kafka.

- Cluster Lifecycle Management: Oversee the full deployment lifecycle of multi-node clusters, including automated installation, configuration, and seamless inline software upgrades across diverse physical and virtual form factors.

- System Reliability & Observability: Develop and support critical infrastructure services, including robust backup and restore frameworks, automated anomaly detection, and comprehensive audit logging to ensure platform reliability and operational transparency.

- Security & Identity Infrastructure: Implement and manage enterprise-grade security protocols, focusing on centralized Authentication and Authorization (AAA) and end-to-end certificate lifecycle management for both cluster-level and microservice-level communications.

- Scalability & Performance Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimize platform scalability and resource efficiency, ensuring the Nexus Dashboard remains a resilient and performant foundation for data center telemetry and orchestration services.
- Bachelors 8+ years related experience or Masters +4 years of related experience.
- Experience programming in languages such as Go and Python, including leveraging AI-assisted development tools to write, test, and optimize code.
- Experience with rapid prototyping of AI solutions and AI workflow/agent engineering.
- Proven experience in developing, deploying, and managing microservices on Kubernetes-based orchestration platforms.
- Experience designing and implementing robust test plans to ensure software quality, reliability, and coverage across all use cases.
- Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and software engineering, with an aptitude for learning new technologies.
before.scoring_formula: 100 × covered requirement weights / all detected requirement weights. Required=3, general=2, preferred=1. No credit for unsupported skills. >90 requires at least five detected skills and no unresolved requirement lines.

SUMIT SINGH JADAUN
Golang/Python Lead Developer | Cloud Native Services and Infrastructure Architect
+91 8073420319 | sumitsinghjadaun@gmail.com | Bangalore, India | Open to roles across India | linkedin.com/in/sumit-singh-jadaun-06a14b23

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Software engineering professional with 13+ years of experience spanning backend services in Golang and Python, infrastructure automation, and converged/hyperconverged infrastructure. Principal Software Engineer experience at Dell Technologies, with contributions to microservice architecture, API design, event-driven integration, and leadership of a Python development team of 8–10 engineers. Hands-on work with Go microservices, Kubernetes, Temporal, Kafka, REST APIs, and gRPC.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Go (Golang), Python | Backend: Microservices, FastAPI, Pydantic, REST APIs, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, OpenAPI, Temporal | Platform: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Linux, Git | Messaging & Security: Apache Kafka, SASL authentication, HashiCorp Vault, authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mTLS, RBAC, audit logging | Automation: Ansible, Python modules | Infrastructure: VMware ESXi, storage, SAN networking

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Dell Technologies | Principal / Senior Software Engineer | Oct 2019–May 2026
Designed REST/gRPC interfaces and Protocol Buffer contracts for Go microservices; created Helm charts defining deployments, services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and service accounts for Kubernetes clusters.
Contributed to the architecture, design, and development of Python microservices using FastAPI and Pydantic for API implementation and data-model validation.
Contributed more than 60% of the cloud-interface microservice code for the On-Prem Cloud Controller; implemented REST APIs and developed Ansible playbooks and Python modules for infrastructure automation.
Built Go services using the Temporal Go SDK to start workflows and handle pause, resume, and cancellation signals; implemented REST interfaces, OpenAPI generation, and gRPC health checks.
Contributed to microservice architecture discussions and evaluated Kafka client libraries through proofs of concept; developed producers and consumers for audit-event and service integration use cases.
Developed authentication (OpenID Connect, mTLS, JWT/bearer-token validation) and authorization (OAuth 2.0, RBAC) APIs; implemented Kafka audit logging with SASL authentication and retry handling for Kafka/Vault connectivity.
Guided technical design discussions, decomposed features into epics and stories, and coordinated with cross-functional teams to resolve engineering dependencies.
Proposed approaches for a monitor-aggregator microservice and centralized shared component-health and pod-status logic in reusable Python framework classes.
Led 8–10 engineers developing the Atlas Python automation framework; implemented logging and reporting enhancements and completed Python 3.6-to-3.14 and plugin migration.
HCL Technologies | Technical Lead / Senior Software Engineer | May 2015–Oct 2019
Riverbed client: Led 3–4 engineers developing Python automation for SteelFusion infrastructure; diagnosed automation-code issues across VMware, storage, and networking environments.
Alcatel-Lucent client: Developed Python scripts for RF and modem-board automation, firmware initialization, and result analysis.
Powerwave Technologies R&D India | Engineer II – Software | Jul 2010–May 2013
Developed Python scripts for radio-hardware interface data analysis and automated workflows using LabVIEW.
